plugins.name: collective
plugins.description: The Collective operator safety floor for Claude Code: a catastrophic-command denylist (recursive root deletion, DROP DATABASE, fork bombs, force-push to protected branches, etc.) plus a protected-file guard, bundled with the c-* workflow skills. Every hook runs locally with ZERO network egress and reads no credentials — a PreToolUse check on Bash commands whose every denial says how to proceed when the matched pattern was only text the command carried, an Edit/Write guard on platform-safety files, a UserPromptSubmit claim-gate contract, and a PostToolUse check that, only inside a Collective-governed repo and only when a new commit's message carries an acceptance-criterion tag (ac:<id>), reads the commit SHA and asks the agent to record it via the collective MCP server, and a PostToolUse check that, after a claude.ai Artifact publish, reads the published local file's size, hash and title and asks the agent to mirror it into The Collective (claude.ai artifacts are readable only by the account that published them). This plugin never calls home on its own: every server call is made by the agent over your own authenticated MCP session.
